# Hardware photography

Product photographs remain the property of their respective manufacturers. Used to identify the devices in an educational hardware comparison, with manufacturer links beside each image. The site's code license does not apply to these photographs.

- `green.webp`: Home Assistant Green — Home Assistant / Nabu Casa. https://www.home-assistant.io/green/
- `n150.webp`: GMKtec NucBox G3 Plus, Intel N150. https://www.gmktec.com/products/nucbox-g3-plus-enhanced-performance-mini-pc-with-intel-n150-processor
- `ryzen5.webp`: Beelink EQR5. https://www.bee-link.com/products/beelink-eqr5
- `ryzen7.webp`: Beelink EQR7. https://www.bee-link.com/products/beelink-eqr7
- The Raspberry Pi photograph is reused from `/static/img/devices/raspberry-pi-5-case.jpg`: Raspberry Pi 5 with M.2 HAT+ Compact and case. https://www.raspberrypi.com/news/m-2-hat-compact-on-sale-now-at-15/

Original download URLs are recorded in `sources.json`. Web copies were resized to at most 800 pixels and encoded as WebP; the pictured hardware was not altered. Photos illustrate the named model/category, not all retailer offers or every memory/storage configuration. Retrieved September 22, 2026.
